newsitem.title: JAPAN: Suzuki in talks on running of India's Maruti.
newsitem.headline: Suzuki in talks on running of India's Maruti.

text.p: Suzuki Motor Corp is in talks with the Indian government on who should to have the initiative in running Maruti Udyog, a fifty-fifty venture between them, Suzuki president Osamu Suzuki told reporters.
The aim is to ensure a quick response to shifts in the automobile market.
Maruti Udyog produces Suzuki-designed compact cars -- the Maruti 800, the Maruti 1000 and the Maruti Zen.
"We need quick decision-making in the Indian automobile market to improve competitiveness, as other foreign carmakers are going to enter the Indian market," Suzuki said.
Suzuki has a 70 percent share of the Indian car market.
Mercedes-Benz, France's Peugeot SA, South Korea's Daewoo Motor Co Ltd, Rover Group Ltd, Adam Opel AG and Ford Motor produce cars in India.
Honda Motor and Mitsubishi Motors Corp are planning to start car production in India within this year. Chrysler Corp, Fiat SpA, and Volkswagen AG are studying the feasibility of entering the market.
